general_information.Time Allocation: Online study + 4.5 hrs offline + PE (Interview 7-10 mins/student)
general_information.Description: This module aims at improving students' listening comprehension and speaking skills. Listening to class lectures and practice of note taking benefit studens in enhancing listening skills. In addition, discussion and presentation tasks offer students opportunities to practice speaking and improve their presentation skills. 1) Ongoing assessment: Student gets 0.5 bonus points for each course completed on time. The total bonus point is not greater than 1. 2) Practical Exam (PE) 3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, PE+ Bonus) 4) Completion Criteria: PE>=4 and FR>=5
general_information.StudentTasks: 1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin. 2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required 3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct 3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded) 4. Communicate and discuss in forum 5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus (optional) 6. Must complete all required MOOCs with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Know how and use note-taking techniques in listening to lectures

Explain complex ideas vividly and accessibly, design clear and compelling presentation slides, convey passion for a topic while maintaining professional credibility, and speak dynamically from notes and/or a manuscript.

assessments.Grading Guide: Teacher(s) interview students to check their understanding and utilization of language acquired from the spec. There should be 4-7 questions covering topics in the spec.
